turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: So can you tell me a little bit about what brought you in here today?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, I've noticed I've had this pretty bad cough for like the last couple of days. A little bit worried. Wanna talk to someone.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, so started two days ago.

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No about what day is it today? Today is Wednesday. It started on Sunday, Sunday. I noticed it getting really bad.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, so it got really bad. Then it was it was it still present but not as bad before that?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah I think I had like a bit of like a raspy cough on like Friday but Sunday it was when I started getting nervous about it.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK so almost a week, it sounds like. And what exactly changed on Sunday that you made it worse in your opinion?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: So Sunday I started bringing I noticed like little spots of red kind of the the gunk I was bringing up.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK.

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: And I kind of ignored it, but the next day they were still there. I started getting fever just in I felt off, you know.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. OK, so that you first notice that on Sunday, were you bringing up sputum before that and it just didn't have these spots or did it, did that part just start on Sunday?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Sputum is kind of like the gunk up and bring it up? Yeah, it was. It's like this yellow custard, it’s got like well spots are red on it on Sunday.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and before that did you have like the yellow custard without red? Or it all started at once all kind of started?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: It all started at once to be honest.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Sorry, I know these are tricky questions, and you said that you've had some fevers. Can you tell me a little bit about that? When did that start?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: So that started, the Monday really is when I first started. I never took my temperature. I just felt hot. You know that's been going on pretty much until today.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, did you ever feel like you were really shaky?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, I've been getting the chills, especially last two days.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. So over this time you've had this cough, have you felt like you've had difficulty breathing?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Not really, I feel a little bit winded doing things. I used to do like I take the stairs up to my apartment, but I have just happened really trying to exert myself that's been taking it easy so I haven't really noticed being out of breath.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, so probably if you were to get up and do a lot of physical activity you would feel worse.

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, I could, probably I can still take the two stairs up to my apartment, but after that I started to feel pretty crummy.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. Is there anything else that you can think of that makes it feel worse?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Has anything helped it to feel better at all?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Bringing up gunk makes it feel better for a little while.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: So you kind of just clear it up and that feels a little bit better?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, I haven't taken some Tylenol at home and that helps a little bit.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, have you felt a sore throat at the same time?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: After an awful lot of coughing, yeah, it starts to feel a little raw.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Have you had a runny nose?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, bit of 1 back in the day, maybe a week ago, but that kind of gone away by now.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Have you felt any chest pain?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah. Yeah I got pain kinda on the right.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. Have you ever have you ever had anything like this before?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No never. Actually Doc, you're saying something that makes it feel worse? Taking a deep breath makes it feel pretty bad.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and. I'm just going to circle back to this chest pain. You said you feel it on the right side. Is it always there or is it just when you take a deep breath or is it kind of on and off?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: It's kind of always there. It gets a little bit worse with coughing and when I take a pretty big deep breath.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Yeah, OK, but if you were just laying down, not coughing, is that pain there?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah yeah, specially notice over the last day,

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK.

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Kind of dull.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. And have you had any weight loss recently?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, not really.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: K. Have you traveled anywhere recently?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Went to Sarnia. About a week back for work but.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, were you in contact with anyone that that was sick?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Nope, just been keeping to myself mostly.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, so in terms of your own medical history, do you have any chronic conditions that you see your family doctor for regularly?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, he’s given me a pill for a cholesterol.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. And do you know the names of any medications that you take?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Lipitor.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK is that the only one?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. Have you ever had any surgeries?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh, my wisdom teeth out as a as a kid. 15 or so I think.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. Do you have any allergies?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: I’m just going to ask you a few questions about your lifestyle and like do you live here in town?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, I live here in town, got a girlfriend living in apartment.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, you live with your girlfriend,

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Do you have any pets?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Cat, yeah.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Do you do anything for work or are you retired?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, I still work a consultant for the chemical plant, so West. Mainly in Sarnia.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: So have you had a lot of exposure to chemicals throughout your career?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Now they've always been pretty good for keeping us safe. I'm on the engineering side of things, so I don't really work too much in the plant directly. You know,

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. Here, well, do you drink alcohol?

turns.text: Once in a blue moon.

turns.text: Do you smoke?

turns.text: OK. Do you use any other substances?

turns.text: Like drugs?

turns.label: Clinician

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Smoke the odd joint from time to time, but haven't in years now.

turns.text: Do you have any family history of any respiratory illnesses?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Respiratory illness, like lungs?

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Yeah, exactly.

turns.text: Think my grandpa died of lung cancer, actually he was a pretty big smoker too though.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. OK, well thank you for sharing all of that with me, so I'm going to go over this with the physician I’m working with and we should be back shortly together to talk to you about the next steps.
